component.name: Snipper
component.summary: Capture a region or the whole screen, and annotate it

description.p: Snipper takes a screenshot and opens it in an editor rather than a file: draw a rectangle around what matters, mark it up, then copy it to the clipboard or save it.

ul.li: Capture a region or the whole screen, with an optional delay
Annotate the result before it goes anywhere
Bind a desktop shortcut to "snipper --region" or "snipper --full"; add "--clipboard" to copy and quit without opening a window
Everything happens on the local machine; the program opens no network connection

description.p: Capturing the whole screen works on GNOME under Wayland, as on Ubuntu 24.04. The first time, GNOME asks whether Snipper may take screenshots.
